title: Contextual spacing compares paragraph styles: a ctx list item after a Normal paragraph with a direct outlineLvl is tight (13.44) like after a plain Normal paragraph, after a Heading1-styled heading it keeps its 12 pt (25.44); a direct w:contextualSpacing on ListParagraph items suppresses between them (13.44) while the first keeps 12 pt after a Normal body and the body after the last keeps the 8 pt after (21.60)
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-10-30), pymupdf span baselines, Letter, Calibri 11 docDefaults after=0 line=240, single pitch 13.44 / 13.20: outline heading -> item 13.44, styled heading -> item 25.44, plain Normal -> item 13.20, body -> lp item one 25.44, lp one -> lp two 13.44, lp two -> body 21.60, ctx para -> outline heading 13.44, ctx para -> styled heading 25.44. gen before the fix: the unstyled stylesheet rule paired p / .doc-li only (the outline heading kept the item's 12 pt) and the plan excluded the direct source for styled paragraphs (12 reported where the page showed 0)

cases.note: Normal + w:outlineLvl renders as h1.doc-outline-only without data-style
item after the outline-only heading: both Normal
item after a plain Normal paragraph
ListParagraph item after a Normal body keeps its before
second ListParagraph item: direct ctx, same style
the unstyled pair rule takes outline-only headings on either side
a ctx paragraph before an outline-only heading drops its space after (13.44), before a styled heading it keeps it (25.44)
